sunny.name: Sunny
sunny.description: A fine day. Business as usual.

cloudy.name: Cloudy
cloudy.description: Overcast. A little quieter on the streets.

rain.name: Rain
rain.description: People hurry indoors. Cafés and card shops fill up; the park empties.

fog.name: Fog
fog.description: Hard to see far. Fewer passers-by notice your shops.

snow.name: Snow
snow.description: Few people brave it, and those who do want something hot.

heat.name: Heatwave
heat.description: Scorching. Cold drinks, ice cream and the water park are in demand.
